message: I remember one particularly hot summer when the power went out during a storm, and let's just say, my ice cream plans went south fast. After that day, I learned a thing or two about staying cool and prepared. If you find yourself in a similar pickle, this resource offers some handy tips on how to beat the heat and keep your family comfortable. What’s your go-to strategy for staying cool when the weather gets a little too toasty? ☀️
